blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around P4.1 million worth of illegal cigarettes hidden inside a refrigerated van was seized by authorities in Negros Occidental, the Bureau of Customs (BOC) reported. The BOC said on Saturday, Nov. 7, that the joint operation with the Philippine National Police (PNP) stemmed from an intelligence report regarding a suspected van carrying 3,754 reams of alleged smuggled cigarettes. The vehicle was intercepted at Ilog town in Negros Occidental on Oct. 21. During the operation, police authorities and personnel of the BOC Port of Iloilo found various imported cigarettes.
